source_metadata.exact_title: Comparing Effectiveness and Safety of SGLT2 Inhibitors vs DPP-4 Inhibitors in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes and Varying Baseline HbA1c Levels
source_metadata.source_type: Original Investigation; observational new-user comparative effectiveness and safety study
source_metadata.data_source: Deidentified Optum Clinformatics Data Mart Database with linked outpatient laboratory results

large_source_strategy: semantic batching because the 13-page primary article is paired with a 34-page table-heavy supplement

substantive_sources.role: methods, definitions, covariate balance, sensitivity analyses

missing_or_unretrieved: Supplement 2 (Data Sharing Statement) is referenced by the article but was not present in the Drive source folder.

sections: Methods: Study Design and Data Source
Results: Study Population and Baseline Characteristics

figures.title: Cumulative Incidence of Modified MACE and HHF

tables.title: Selected Baseline Characteristics Before/After PS Matching
tables.representation: structured summary; key balance findings retained

batch_manifest.scope: Title/abstract, design, eligibility, population, exposure/comparator, outcomes, matching and follow-up
Primary and secondary effectiveness outcomes, HbA1c subgroup analyses, cumulative incidence
Safety outcomes overall and by HbA1c
Limitations, conclusion, correction, funding, conflicts, data sharing

coverage_decision: All main-text figures/table and all Supplement 1 methods, eTables, and eFigures were inspected. Large baseline tables were summarized at the balance/validity level rather than row-by-row atomized; bibliography was used for the task queue but not atomized.

omissions.reason: Not required to preserve the study claim; balance and key subgroup differences were retained.
References are provenance infrastructure, not primary-study assertions.
